payload.title: Integrate live fusion -> targeted worker re-entry with ACK/replay

work_clay.purpose: Make incoming material deltas enter an append-only live fusion stream, route only to semantically affected workers, require explicit worker ACK/plan revision, and replay unacked deltas after restart.
work_clay.hard_separation: Database Pulse physical projection effectivization != worker knowledge re-entry
work_clay.aba_rule: Equal content/payload hash never erases a newer event/epoch/record-version/provenance identity.
work_clay.effect_guard: Only an unacked high-impact conflict intersecting the intended effect blocks the next affected effect.

reason_clay.current_gap: CLAY_WORK_EVENT_PROTOCOL materializes work lifecycle events but does not make knowledge-delta delivery/ACK/re-entry first-class observable transport.
reason_clay.live_observation: Multiple main-branch commits arrived during this ChatGPT run and materially changed UnifiedDB Pulse, ClayCode and capability state, proving the need for intra-run delta fusion rather than one refresh per chat.
reason_clay.current_counterevidence: Pulse S2 ABA findings show that final content equality is insufficient to cancel record/version/provenance-bound causal identity.

completion_clay.negative_control: irrelevant workers remain INDEX_ONLY/no plan churn
completion_clay.promotion: Only after no simpler current mechanism dominates under correctness+latency+recovery+coordination-noise metrics

dependencies: identity lock and live refresh protocols remain satisfied
invalidators: PR156 refuted or superseded by a simpler measured mechanism
newer main evidence makes event-id/ACK/replay semantics unsafe
